items.title: Movement characteristics of persistent extreme precipitation events over China during the warm season using high spatiotemporal resolution data
items.title_en: Movement characteristics of persistent extreme precipitation events over China during the warm season using high spatiotemporal resolution data
items.title_zh: 利用高时空分辨率数据研究中国暖季持续性极端降水事件的移动特征
items.summary_en: Moving persistent extreme precipitation events (PEPEs) can cause severe disasters along their tracks. However, a PEPE typically consists of multiple rain cells that evolve and move differently from one another, rendering the conventional single-center tracking method incapable of capturing their respective characteristics. Here we use a multi-rain cell tracking method to characterize the movement of PEPEs during the warm season (May to September) over China, utilizing high-resolution precipitation data at half‐hourly temporal and 0.1° spatial resolutions for the period 1998–2024. Based on the movement distance and direction, PEPEs are clustered into the long-distance eastward-moving, short-distance eastward-moving, northeastward-moving, and westward-moving types, which are most prevalent over Southeast China, the Tibetan Plateau (TP), Northeast China, and the southern China, respectively. Temporally, the frequency of these four types of events peaks progressively from May to August, and the PEPEs with longer movement distances tend to occur in the early morning. In terms of large-scale circulation patterns, long-distance eastward-moving PEPEs are favored by the southwestward extension of the Western Pacific Subtropical High (WPSH); short-distance eastward-moving PEPEs are associated with a meridional dipole of geopotential height anomaly around the TP; the northeastward-moving type is likely influenced by a wave-train circulation pattern in high latitudes; westward-moving PEPEs occur more frequently when the WPSH extends northwestward. These findings provide a comprehensive climatology of PEPE movement and highlight distinct circulation controls, which may aid in the prediction of moving extreme precipitations.
items.summary_zh: 移动性持续极端降水事件（PEPE）会在其路径沿线引发严重灾害。然而，一个PEPE通常由多个降水单元组成，这些单元的发展和移动方式各不相同，导致传统的单中心追踪方法无法捕捉其各自的特征。 本文采用多雨团追踪方法，利用1998–2024年间半小时时间分辨率和0.1°空间分辨率的高分辨率降水数据，对中国暖季（5月至9月）期间PEPE的移动特征进行了分析。 根据移动距离和方向，将 PEPE 分为长距离向东移动型、短距离向东移动型、向东北移动型和向西移动型，它们分别在中国东南、青藏高原（TP）、中国东北和中国南部最为常见。 从时间上看，这四类事件的发生频率从 5 月到 8 月逐渐达到高峰，而移动距离较长的 PEPE 往往发生在清晨。 就大尺度环流模式而言，西太平洋副热带高压（WPSH）向西南方向延伸有利于长距离向东移动的PEPE；短距离向东移动的PEPE与青藏高原（TP）周边地势高度异常的子午向双极结构有关； 向东北移动的类型可能受高纬度波列环流模式的影响；当西太平洋副热带高压向西北延伸时，向西移动的PEPE发生频率更高。这些发现为PEPE的移动提供了全面的气候学分析，并突出了不同的环流控制机制，这可能有助于预测移动性极端降水。

items.title: High-resolution soil moisture forecasts for drought early warning in Germany
items.title_en: High-resolution soil moisture forecasts for drought early warning in Germany
items.title_zh: 用于德国干旱预警的高分辨率土壤湿度预报
items.summary_en: Drought early warning increasingly relies on high-resolution monitoring, but the skill of daily soil moisture forecasts at lead times of 1–2 weeks driven by real-time meteorological ensembles has rarely been evaluated directly against an operational drought-monitoring framework. The Hydrological Sub-seasonal Forecasting System (HS2S) extends an established national drought-monitoring framework into high-resolution probabilistic soil moisture forecasts up to two weeks ahead for Germany at resolution. We evaluated a daily-initialised HS2S configuration using the 51-member real-time forecast ensemble from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts during the exceptionally dry spring and summer of 2025 against the operational, model-based German Drought Monitor (GDM), generated within the same mesoscale Hydrologic Model (mHM) framework using observation-based meteorological forcing. The assessment combined drought onset/recovery transition diagnostics with probabilistic (Brier skill score) and categorical verification against an initialised two-state Markov persistence benchmark, and continuous verification against an mHM soil moisture climatology. HS2S reproduced the timing and mean magnitude of GDM-indicated drought onset and recovery. It showed positive probabilistic skill relative to the initialised Markov benchmark and positive continuous skill relative to the 1950–2017 mHM climatology at both lead times. For moderate drought ( ), the critical success index improved by 15.0 and 15.5 percentage points at lead weeks 1 and 2, respectively. The probability of detection of GDM-indicated drought was 95% and 89% at the same lead times. Given HS2S and the GDM share the same mHM–Soil Moisture Index framework and initial states, the verification is model-consistent and evaluates skill in anticipating the GDM-indicated drought state rather than validating absolute soil moisture accuracy. The added value of real-time meteorological forecasts relative to historical meteorological sequences was not assessed. Within this operationally relevant framework, HS2S showed forecast skill up to two weeks ahead during the 2025 drought, highlighting the potential of high-resolution probabilistic soil moisture forecasts to complement national drought monitoring with forward-looking information.
items.summary_zh: 干旱预警越来越依赖于高分辨率监测，但基于实时气象集合预报、预测期为1至2周的日土壤含水率预报的准确性，鲜少直接与实际运行的干旱监测框架进行对比评估。 水文亚季节预报系统（HS2S）将现有的国家干旱监测框架扩展至德国境内，可提供分辨率高达、预报期最长为两周的高分辨率概率性土壤湿度预报。 我们利用欧洲中期天气预报中心提供的51组实时预报集合，对2025年异常干旱的春季和夏季期间每日初始化的HS2S配置进行了评估，并将评估结果与基于模型的德国干旱监测系统（GDM）进行了对比， 该监测系统同样基于观测气象强迫，在同一中尺度水文模型（mHM）框架内生成。评估结合了干旱起始/恢复过渡诊断，采用概率性（布里尔技能评分）和分类验证方法，以初始化双态马尔可夫持续性基准为参照，并针对mHM土壤湿度气候学数据进行连续验证。 HS2S 再现了 GDM 指示的干旱起始和恢复的时间点及平均程度。在两个预测时效下，该模型相对于初始化马尔可夫基准均表现出正的概率技能，相对于 1950–2017 年 mHM 气候学数据也表现出正的连续技能。 对于中度干旱（ ），在第1周和第2周的预测期，关键成功指数分别提高了15.0和15.5个百分点。在相同的预测期，GDM指示的干旱的检出概率分别为95%和89%。 鉴于HS2S和GDM采用相同的mHM–土壤湿度指数框架和初始状态，该验证在模型上具有一致性，其评估重点在于预测GDM指示的干旱状态的能力，而非验证绝对土壤湿度的准确性。实时气象预报相对于历史数据的附加价值

items.title: Ground-based GNSS transmissometry reveals contrasting leaf and stem water dynamics in a central Amazon rainforest
items.title_en: Ground-based GNSS transmissometry reveals contrasting leaf and stem water dynamics in a central Amazon rainforest
items.title_zh: 基于地面的GNSS透射率测量揭示了亚马逊中部雨林中叶片与茎秆水分动态的差异
items.summary_en: Vegetation optical depth (VOD) is widely used to monitor vegetation water dynamics, yet its interpretation in dense tropical forests remains uncertain because independent observations of water partitioning among vegetation compartments are scarce. Here, we compare global navigation satellite system transmissometry-derived VOD (GNSS-T VOD) with independent measurements of leaf, stem, and soil water in an old-growth Central Amazon rainforest. Stem water storage (SWS) dominated total vegetation water storage (VWS) and closely tracked seasonal soil moisture. In contrast, GNSS-T VOD exhibited opposing relationships with vegetation water compartments, being positively associated with leaf water storage (r = 0.65, p = 0.16) but negatively correlated with SWS and total VWS (both r = −0.83, p < 0.05). These contrasting relationships show that temporal variation in GNSS-T VOD cannot be explained by total VWS alone. Instead, these relationships highlight the importance of water partitioning among vegetation compartments when interpreting GNSS-T VOD. These observations provide a benchmark for interpreting L-band VOD in high-biomass tropical forests.
items.summary_zh: 植被光学厚度（VOD）被广泛用于监测植被水分动态，但在茂密的热带森林中，由于缺乏对植被各组分间水分分配的独立观测数据，其解释仍存在不确定性。 在此，我们对比了全球导航卫星系统透射率法衍生的植被光学深度（GNSS-T VOD）与亚马逊中部原始雨林中叶片、茎干和土壤水分的独立测量数据。茎干储水量（SWS）在植被总储水量（VWS）中占主导地位，且与季节性土壤湿度呈密切相关。 相比之下，GNSS-T VOD 与植被水分组分呈现相反的关系：它与叶片储水量呈正相关（r = 0.65，p = 0.16），但与茎干储水量和总植被储水量均呈负相关（r = −0.83，p < 0.05）。 这些截然不同的关系表明，GNSS-T VOD的时变性不能仅由总植被储水量（VWS）来解释。相反，这些关系突显了在解释GNSS-T VOD时，植被各水库之间水分分配的重要性。这些观测结果为解读高生物量热带森林中的L波段VOD提供了基准。

items.title: Scale-aware emergent constraints on Tibetan Plateau warming: contrasting global and regional predictors
items.title_en: Scale-aware emergent constraints on Tibetan Plateau warming: contrasting global and regional predictors
items.title_zh: 青藏高原变暖的尺度敏感型自发约束：全球与区域预测因子的对比
items.summary_en: Emergent constraints are increasingly used to reduce uncertainty in regional climate projections by exploiting relationships across models between observable historical predictors and projected changes. However, the choice of historical window and predictor scale can strongly affect constraint performance. Using the Tibetan Plateau (TP), a region of complex terrain, as a testbed, we compare two widely used predictors for constraining future TP warming: large-scale global mean surface air temperature (GSAT) and regional TP surface air temperature (TPSAT). We show that GSAT-based constraints are sensitive to the temporal evolution of external forcing and are strongest for windows beginning around 1980, consistent with the differing historical effects of greenhouse gases and aerosols. In contrast, TPSAT-based constraints generally become stronger with longer windows, indicating that extended records help suppress internal variability and better reveal the regional forced signal. At the local scale, GSAT performs better in lower-elevation regions, whereas TPSAT is more skillful over high-elevation and topographically complex areas where regional process-related signals, including cryosphere-related feedbacks, may be more important. Motivated by this spatial contrast, we develop a scale-aware constraint framework that selects the locally preferred predictor at each grid point and reduces projection uncertainty relative to either single-predictor approach over large parts of the Plateau. These findings highlight the importance of scale-aware observational constraints and may inform constrained projections in other high-elevation and topographically complex regions.
items.summary_zh: 为了利用不同模型间可观测的历史预测变量与预测变化之间的关系，从而降低区域气候预测中的不确定性，新兴约束法正被越来越广泛地应用。然而，历史时间窗口和预测变量尺度的选择会显著影响约束法的性能。 我们以地形复杂的青藏高原（TP）作为研究平台，对比了两种广泛用于约束未来青藏高原变暖的预测因子：大尺度全球平均地表气温（GSAT）和青藏高原区域地表气温（TPSAT）。 我们表明，基于GSAT的约束对外部强迫的时序演变较为敏感，且在始于1980年左右的窗口内约束效果最强，这与温室气体和气溶胶在历史上的不同影响一致。 相比之下，基于 TPSAT 的约束通常随时间窗口的延长而增强，这表明更长的观测记录有助于抑制内部变异性，并更好地揭示区域受迫信号。 在局部尺度上，GSAT 在低海拔地区表现更好，而 TPSAT 在高海拔和地形复杂的地区更有效，在这些地区，与区域过程相关的信号（包括与冰冻圈相关的反馈）可能更为重要。 受这一空间对比的启发，我们开发了一个“尺度感知”约束框架，该框架在每个网格点上选择当地最优的预测因子，并相对于两种单预测因子方法，在青藏高原的大部分地区降低了预测不确定性。 这些发现突显了尺度感知观测约束的重要性，并可能为其他高海拔和地形复杂地区的约束投影提供参考。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 06 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01982-wPhotocatalytic nitrogen fixation can make ammonia from nitrogen and water under mild conditions, but slow nitrogen delivery and product build-up limit output. Now, a floating solar interface couples nitrogen reduction with evaporation, greatly speeding up ammonia formation and concentrating a high-purity product in the condensate.

items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.10886v1 An: new Abstract: The order of accuracy sets how fast numerical error falls as the timestep shortens. This study measured that order for the zone heat balance of EnergyPlus 26.2 against exact or converged references and tested a correction on 45 U.S. Department of Energy prototype cases. All three zone air formulas, the third-order default included, give first order or lower, because the surfaces use the previous timestep's air temperature. Solving surfaces, air and HVAC to agreement within each timestep raises the default to about second order, and in a room with an exact solution two extra passes cut the error eightfold at 1.65 times the runtime. items.title: Scientists discover Europe's ancient forests were nothing like we imagined
items.title_en: Scientists discover Europe's ancient forests were nothing like we imagined
items.title_zh: 科学家发现，欧洲的远古森林与我们想象的截然不同
items.summary_en: Scientists have uncovered evidence that Europe was dominated for more than 20 million years by open woodlands, colorful meadows, and large grazing animals, not the dense forests long considered its natural state. The surprising discovery challenges modern reforestation strategies, suggesting that planting thick forests could actually harm the biodiversity conservationists hope to protect.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们发现了证据，表明欧洲在超过2000万年的时间里，主要由开阔的林地、色彩斑斓的草甸和大型食草动物所占据，而非长期以来被认为是其自然状态的密林。这一令人惊讶的发现对现代造林策略提出了挑战，表明种植密林实际上可能会损害保护主义者希望保护的生物多样性。

Unlike fossil fuel emissions, however, the CO2 we exhale is part of the natural carbon cycle, and scientists say measuring it more accurately could improve climate models.

items.title: In the image of their tools | Science
items.title_en: In the image of their tools | Science
items.title_zh: 以他们的工具为镜 | 科学
items.summary_en: In the United States, spending on AI infrastructure now dwarfs investment in the Internet and railroads combined, but spending on the institutions that would let societies absorb that technology is, by comparison, negligible. This asymmetry creates a paradox. Models post striking benchmark scores while aggregate economic output barely moves: Economist Daron Acemoglu projects a total factor productivity gain of well under one percent over a decade, and firm-level studies find that task-level gains do not necessarily add up at the firm or economy level. This paradox follows from an institutional mismatch that can be addressed by reverse alignment, the deliberate redesign of institutions, norms, and skills, rather than of models, so that societies can absorb new forms of machine cognition.
items.summary_zh: 在美国，目前对人工智能基础设施的投入已远超互联网和铁路投资的总和，但相比之下，用于建设能够帮助社会吸收这项技术的机构的投入却微乎其微。这种不对称性造成了一种悖论。 模型在基准测试中取得了惊人的成绩，但总体经济产出却几乎没有变化：《经济学人》杂志的达龙·阿塞莫格鲁预测，未来十年的全要素生产率增幅将远低于1%；而企业层面的研究发现，任务层面的收益并不一定能累积到企业或经济层面。 这一悖论源于制度错配，可通过“反向对齐”来解决——即有意识地重新设计制度、规范和技能（而非模型），从而使社会能够吸收机器认知的新形式。
